title: Norton and Avast Earn Recognition in Independent Cybersecurity Tests
summary: Independent testing shows how Norton and Avast perform against real-world threats, while helping us measure progress and keep improving protection for the people who count on us.
body_markdown:
Each result reflects a particular test, method and time period. Together, they offer a view into how our brands performed across a range of assessments. Testing institutions include:


- [SE Labs](https://selabs.uk/)
- [AVLab](https://avlab.org/)
- [AV-Comparatives](https://av-comparatives.org/)
- [AV-Test](https://av-test.org/en/)


## A strong result is a responsibility


Awards are worth celebrating, but they are not the finish line. Cybersecurity is a moving target. New scams, malicious sites and malware keep emerging, and protection needs to keep pace.


That is why we put our brands through independent testing. It helps us see how our products perform against defined standards and gives us valuable feedback as we continue to develop them. The goal is not simply to earn recognition. It is to continue improving so we can build protection people can rely on in the moments that matter.


Whether someone is working on their laptop, browsing on a computer or shopping online, the protections they count on need to work in the real world. Dependable cybersecurity is essential.


Norton and Avast serve people in different ways, but they share a commitment to helping people stay safer online. Independent results across both brands reflect the scale of that work and the teams who test, research and improve our products.


## The standard keeps moving


Strong results show where we stand today. The work continues because the threats continue.


We’ll keep testing our products, learning from independent evaluations and pushing for better performance. That is how we measure progress: against clear standards, evolving threats and the needs of the people who count on us.
